info.name: F5 XC - Vuln-Bank Setup
info.description:
Postman collection for managing Namespaces in F5 Distributed Cloud (XC).

API Reference: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/namespace

## Setup
Set the following collection variables before use:
- `xc_tenant` — your tenant name (e.g. `mycompany`)
- `xc_api_token` — your F5 XC API token (from Console > Administration > Credentials)

request.description:
Gets tenant information by listing namespaces. Every F5 XC API response includes metadata.tenant with the full tenant name (e.g. mandiritunas-abc12345).

The Test script automatically extracts the tenant name from the first namespace in the response and stores it in the collection variable 'xc_tenant_fullname'.

Run this request FIRST before using Origin Pool or any other request that references {{xc_tenant_fullname}}.

API Ref: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/namespace
Operation: ves.io.schema.namespace.API.List

Creates HTTP Load Balancer 'lb-vuln-bank' in namespace vuln-bank.

Prerequisites (run in order):
1. Get Tenant Info — sets {{xc_tenant_fullname}}
2. Create Health Check - tcp-monitor
3. Create Origin Pool - origin-vuln-bank
4. Create App Firewall - policy-vuln-bank

Collection variable required:
- vulnbank_base_url: domain name only, e.g. vulnbank.example.com (no https://)

API Ref: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-http-loadbalancer
Operation: ves.io.schema.views.http_loadbalancer.API.Create
Endpoint: POST /api/config/namespaces/{namespace}/http_loadbalancers

Lists all HTTP load balancers in namespace vuln-bank.

API Ref: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-http-loadbalancer
Operation: ves.io.schema.views.http_loadbalancer.API.List

API Ref: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-http-loadbalancer
Operation: ves.io.schema.views.http_loadbalancer.API.Get

Deletes the lb-vuln-bank HTTP load balancer. WARNING: This removes the LB and its DNS/cert config.

API Ref: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-http-loadbalancer
Operation: ves.io.schema.views.http_loadbalancer.API.Delete
